title: Separate the Wheat from the Chaff: A Post-Hoc Approach to Safety Re-Alignment for Fine-Tuned Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety realignment to mitigate harmful outputs and jailbreak attacks in fine-tuned LLMs. While it mentions human values and safety, its evaluation is centered on harm prevention (safety scores) and does not specifically investigate religious topics, moral reasoning frameworks, or ethics as a primary component of its benchmarking.
